Table - Register Definition.Description: USB2 controller version register. Reports the IP major and minor version numbers.

Bits.Description:
Major version number of the IP. Software reads it to select a compatible driver.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: 16-bit unsigned value.

Minor version number of the IP. Software reads it to identify compatible additions.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x0 minor version 0 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: 16-bit unsigned value.

Table - Register Definition.Description: USB2 controller global control register. Enables the core, resets it and selects the role override.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Link loopback. Feeds the transmitted packet bytes back into the packet receiver inside the link and isolates the PHY pins.

Usage: Write before core_en for bring-up tests without a PHY; clear for normal operation; counters are in u2_lpbk_sts.

Values:
0x0 normal operation (reset value);
0x1 link loopback.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Stop on bus error. Disables the DMA of the failing endpoint or channel after an AXI error response.

Usage: Leave 1 so that a faulty buffer address cannot corrupt memory further.

Values:
0x0 continue after an AXI error;
0x1 stop the transfer on an AXI error (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

DMA enable. Lets the AXI4 master DMA or the DMA request logic serve FIFO traffic.

Usage: Set after the dma_cfg and the endpoint or channel address registers are programmed.

Values:
0x0 DMA disabled, software moves data through the FIFO window (reset value);
0x1 DMA enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Role override value. Selects the role used when role_ovr_en is 1.

Usage: Valid only when role_ovr_en is 1; change only while no device is attached.

Values:
0x0 device role (reset value);
0x1 host role.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Role override enable. Ignores the ID indication of the PHY in a dual-role build.

Usage: Write before core_en; used when the board has no ID pin or for tests.

Values:
0x0 role follows the PHY ID indication (reset value);
0x1 role follows role_ovr.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

PHY reset output. Drives o_phy_rst_n to the PHY.

Usage: Set to hold the PHY in reset; clear after the PHY supply and clock are stable.

Values:
0x0 PHY reset released;
0x1 PHY held in reset.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Core soft reset. Returns all protocol state of the CLK-PHY domain to its reset value while the registers keep their values.

Usage: Software writes 1; hardware clears the bit when the reset has finished in both clock domains; poll it before reprogramming.

Values:
0x0 no reset pending (reset value);
0x1 reset requested or in progress.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Core enable. Lets the protocol engines, the FIFO manager and the PHY interface run.

Usage: Set after the FIFO regions, the endpoint or channel registers and the DMA registers are programmed; clear before changing PARA-independent role or FIFO settings.

Values:
0x0 core disabled, the bus side is idle (reset value);
0x1 core enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: USB2 controller status register. Reports the live role, speed, line and VBUS state.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Free command entries. The number of free entries of the register command FIFO that carries CSR writes to the CLK-PHY domain.

Usage: Read before a burst of writes to endpoint, channel, FIFO, role or enable fields; issue at most this many writes before reading it again.

Values:
0x0 FIFO full: further writes to crossing fields are dropped and xq_ovf is set;
0x1 to 0x8 free entries (reset value 0x8);
0x9 to 0x3F reserved.

Unit: entry.

Limits: 0 to 8.

PHY clock present. Shows that CLK-PHY toggles.

Usage: Poll after releasing phy_rst; the CSR stays accessible without the PHY clock.

Values:
0x0 PHY clock absent (reset value);
0x1 PHY clock present.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Reset busy. Shows that a soft reset or a bus reset sequence is running.

Usage: Poll after writing swrst or after a port reset.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

ID indication. Shows the plug type that the PHY reports.

Usage: Read in dual-role builds; the value is meaningful after the PHY ID sampling time of 50 ms.

Values:
0x0 B plug, device (reset value);
0x1 A plug, host.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

VBUS valid. Shows that VBUS is above the operating threshold.

Usage: Read before enabling the device role pull-up or the host VBUS drive.

Values:
0x0 VBUS below threshold (reset value);
0x1 VBUS valid.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Suspend state. Shows that the bus is suspended or in L1 sleep.

Usage: Read after the suspend or resume interrupt.

Values:
0x0 bus active (reset value);
0x1 bus suspended.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Attach state. Shows that a device is connected (host role) or a host drives VBUS (device role).

Usage: Read after the conn or disc interrupt.

Values:
0x0 not attached (reset value);
0x1 attached.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Active role. Shows whether the controller currently acts as host or device.

Usage: Read after the role_chg interrupt; valid when core_en is 1.

Values:
0x0 device role (reset value);
0x1 host role.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: USB2 controller build configuration register. Reports the elaboration parameters of this build.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

RAM parity parameter. Reports whether PARA_USB2_RAM_PAR_EN is 1.

Usage: Read at probe time; the ram_par interrupt exists only when 1.

Values:
0x0 no RAM parity;
0x1 RAM parity present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Double-buffer parameter. Reports whether PARA_USB2_DBUF_EN is 1.

Usage: Read at probe time; dbuf fields have no effect when 0.

Values:
0x0 no double buffering;
0x1 double buffering present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Scatter-gather parameter. Reports whether PARA_USB2_SG_EN is 1.

Usage: Read at probe time; sg_mode has no effect when 0.

Values:
0x0 no scatter-gather DMA (reset value);
0x1 scatter-gather DMA present.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

FIFO depth parameter. Reports the base-2 logarithm of PARA_USB2_FIFO_DEPTH in 32-bit words.

Usage: Read at probe time before dividing the FIFO.

Values:
0x8 to 0xF depth of 2 to the power of the value words (reset value 0xA, 1024 words);
0x0 to 0x7 reserved.

Unit: none.

Limits: 0x8 to 0xF, depth 256 to 32768 words.

Host channel count parameter. Reports PARA_USB2_NUM_HC.

Usage: Read at probe time.

Values:
0x1 to 0x10 host channels (reset value 0x8).

Unit: count.

Limits: 1 to 16.

Endpoint count parameter. Reports PARA_USB2_NUM_EP, the endpoints besides EP0.

Usage: Read at probe time.

Values:
0x1 to 0xF endpoints besides EP0 (reset value 0x8).

Unit: count.

Limits: 1 to 15.

Split parameter. Reports whether PARA_USB2_SPLIT_EN is 1.

Usage: Read at probe time; hc_spl fields do nothing when 0.

Values:
0x0 no split (reset value);
0x1 split present.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

LPM parameter. Reports whether PARA_USB2_LPM_EN is 1.

Usage: Read at probe time; LPM fields do nothing when 0.

Values:
0x0 no LPM (reset value);
0x1 LPM present.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Data interface parameter. Reports whether the build uses the AXI4 slave port with DMA request and acknowledge.

Usage: Read at probe time.

Values:
0x0 AXI4 master DMA (reset value);
0x1 AXI4 slave with DMA handshake.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

UTMI+ width parameter. Reports whether the UTMI+ interface is 16 bits wide.

Usage: Read at probe time; it fixes the CLK-PHY frequency at 30 MHz.

Values:
0x0 8-bit (reset value);
0x1 16-bit.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

PHY interface parameter. Reports whether the build uses ULPI.

Usage: Read at probe time.

Values:
0x0 UTMI+ (reset value);
0x1 ULPI.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Limits: none.

0x1 to 0x7F assigned address.

Unit: none.

Limits: 7-bit value.

Table - Register Definition.Description: USB2 host channel extension register. Selects double buffering, packet termination and interval polling of one channel.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Current buffer. Shows which of the two buffers the bus side uses next.

Usage: Read for debug when dbuf is 1.

Values:
0x0 buffer A (reset value);
0x1 buffer B.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Polling interval. The number of microframes (high-speed) or frames (full-speed and low-speed) between two transactions.

Usage: Write before ch_en from the bInterval of the endpoint descriptor.

Values:
0x1 to 0xFFFF intervals (reset value 0x1).

Unit: microframe or frame.

Limits: 1 to 65535.

Poll repeat. Re-arms the channel automatically after each completed transfer while poll_en is 1.

Usage: Set when software consumes each packet before the next interval; otherwise the poll_miss flag is set.

Values:
0x0 stop after one transfer (reset value);
0x1 repeat every interval.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Interval polling. Makes the host issue the transaction of the channel once per interval.

Usage: Set for interrupt and isochronous channels before ch_en; hardware retries a NAK or NYET at the next interval.

Values:
0x0 one transfer per ch_en (reset value);
0x1 polled every interval.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

End on short packet. Ends an IN transfer at the first packet shorter than the maximum packet size.

Usage: Set before ch_en for bulk IN channels with messages of unknown length.

Values:
0x0 transfer ends when xsize is 0 (reset value);
0x1 transfer ends on a short packet.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Automatic zero-length packet. Sends a zero-length packet after the last full OUT packet when the transfer size is a multiple of the maximum packet size.

Usage: Set before ch_en for bulk OUT channels.

Values:
0x0 software adds the packet (reset value);
0x1 hardware adds the packet.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Double buffering. Splits the channel region into two packet buffers used alternately.

Usage: Set before ch_en; has effect only when PARA_USB2_DBUF_EN is 1.

Values:

Unit: none.
